Even though the Moon is technically above the horizon, it's **not visible** under these conditions.

---

### 📅 **When Will the Moon Be Visible?**

The Moon will be visible to the naked eye when it is at least **20–30% illuminated** and **several degrees away from the Sun** (i.e., not in daylight). That typically happens a few days after the new moon.
